title: Saka MySejahtera
overview: This story tells how the situation of a village named Kampung Keras Kepala was hit by Covid-19. However, they were not only hit by Covid-19, but also received a ghost attack. The ghosts and Saka often harass the villagers who do not follow the set SOPs. Remy, a village youth who is also the son of the Tok Penghulu, started the investigation as to who was the mastermind behind all the incidents.
